Want to restore the planet’s ecosystems and see your impact in monthly videos? The first 100 people to join Planet Wild with my code KURZGESAGT9 will get the first month paid for by me: https://planetwild.com/r/kurzgesagt/join/9  If you want to get to know them better first, check out their wildlife crossings mission: https://planetwild.com/r/kurzgesagt/m36/9

Be among the first to know when the 12,027 Calendar drops! Sign up to our newsletter and and stay in the loop on all things kurzgesagt: https://shop.kgs.link/i-want-to-know-first

Sources & further reading:
https://sites.google.com/view/sourcesbarrowscale/

We imagine advanced alien civilizations building gigantic spaceships, Dyson spheres and empires spanning entire galaxies. But what if true technological progress goes in exactly the opposite direction? Not outward into space, but deeper and deeper into the smallest layers of reality?

What is the Barrow Scale? How powerful could a civilization become by mastering DNA, and even fundamental particles, and could the universe already be filled with godlike civilizations hiding in plain sight?

snippet.description:
Movie Night at Bengaluru Mall 🎬✨ | Mini Vlog

Aaj ka mini vlog thoda different aur full chill vibes wala hai 🎬✨

Aaj main aur mere friend Bengaluru ke ek mall mein movie dekhne ke liye nikle 🍿🎥 Sabse pehle mall ke andar entry, phir INOX ke outside cafeteria ke kuch moments aur mere friend ke saath walking shots 📸

Movie khatam hone ke baad INOX se bahar nikalte hue aur mall ke andar ke beautiful views capture kiye 🏢✨ Mall ke andar ki lighting aur decoration ne pura vibe hi change kar diya 💡😍

Uske baad parking mein gaye, car lekar mall se bahar nikle 🚗🌃 Aur finally night mein mall ka outside view capture karke aaj ke mini vlog ko end kiya ❤️

Simple day, good movie, friends aur beautiful mall vibes… sometimes these little moments become the best memories! ✨
Video pasand aaye to Like 👍 Comment 💬 aur Channel ko Subscribe zaroor karein ❤️
